custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations, the test location and location B, so the change can be seen at both.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location and at location B under the same part number, so both share one Part Library entry.
  • Use a new part number, number 2, that no part or Part Library entry uses.
  • Start at the test location on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425774-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425774-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 2:

  • Under the field: "This also changes the part number at 1 other location."

Step 3:

  • The save goes through.

Step 4:

  • Part A is listed with the new value.

Step 5:

  • The newest entry reads "Part number updated | Original number:" followed by part A's old number, "| New number:" and number 2, with nothing after it.

Step 6:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 7:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 8:

  • Location B's Inventory page opens.

Step 9:

  • Part A is listed at location B with the new value.

Step 10:

  • The newest entry reads "Part number updated | Original number:" followed by part A's old number, "| New number:" and number 2, followed by "| Changed at:" and the test location's name: it names the location where the change was made.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S10-R23: “A changed part number writes "Part number updated | Original number: {old} | New number: {new}" to the Part History of the part at every location that stocks it.”
  • S10-R25: “On the entries written at the other locations, the line ends with "| Changed at: {location}", naming the location where the change was made.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part number changed on a part other locations stock | "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
